content.title: USA vs. Dominican Republic FREE STREAM today: Where to watch World Baseball Classic semifinals
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.MIAMI – Two heavy hitters collide as the United States battles the Dominican Republic in a star-studded semifinal of the World Baseball Classic today – Sunday, March 15 – at loanDepot Park in Miami, Florida. This game is available to watch on multiple streaming services for free. How do I watch Team USA vs. Dominican Republic for free? The game will broadcast live on FS1 with the first pitch at 8 p.m. Eastern. Those who have cut the cable cord can catch the game for free by utilizing streaming alternatives like FuboTV ($25 off first month) and DIRECTV ($40 off first month), which are currently both offering a free trial. The most flexible option is Sling TV, which now offers new users a Day Pass for $4.99, Weekend Pass for $9.99, Week Pass for $14.99, Monthly for $45.99 and Season Pass for $199.99 for five months and $45.99 per month thereafter. Table not scrollableWhile the U.S. vs. Shohei Ohtani and Japan was viewed as the ultimate grand finale in the WBC, today’s game will feature the most star power of any possible combination in the tournament. The projected starting lineup for both teams has combined for 52 All-Star Games, 32 Silver Sluggers, 11 Gold Gloves and five MVPs. Team USADefending NL Cy Young winner and Pittsburgh Pirates ace Paul Skenes takes the mound for the Stars and Stripes with the run support of back-to-back AL MVP Aaron Judge, home run guru Cal Raleigh and superstar Kyle Schwarber, among other notable MLB heavyweights. The United States is coming off a 5-3 win vs. Canada in the quarterfinals. Five runs likely won’t get the job done against the DR’s mashing lineup. Having Skenes helps. He went four scoreless innings against Mexico with seven strikeouts. In contrast to the DR’s run machine, the Americans have scored a combined 40 runs with seven home runs in the tournament. The United States has topped 10 runs just once. Team USA’s only loss was against semifinalist Italy in Group Play. The Italians remain undefeated and will battle Venezuela in the second semifinal on March 16. Team USA top performersKyle Schwarber .350 batting average, one home run, three RBI and seven hitsRoman Anthony.316 batting average, one home run, six RBI and six hitsBrice Turang.467 batting average, four doubles, five RBI and seven hits. Watch USA vs. Dominican Republic for free on DIRECTVDominican RepublicFor pride and country, Juan Soto, Vladimir Guerrero, Manny Machado, Fernando Tatis Jr. and Junior Caminero take their best shot against the United States with an incredibly impressive core lineup. Athletics star Luis Severino will get the honor to open on the mound against the Americans lineup. The Dominican Republic submitted Korea, 10-0, in seven innings of the quarterfinals. The DR has crushed 14 home runs in five games and reached 10 runs in four of its last five. The powerhouse has gone 5-0 in this year’s tournament, totaling 51 runs overall.
